details: @ubedsockets/baileys republishes the Baileys WhatsApp library under an unofficial scope with undisclosed additions. lib/Socket/socket.js installs an "IP PROTECTION SYSTEM" whose verifyIP() runs unconditionally from the socket constructor: it requests hxxps://api[.]ipify[.]org?format=json, compares the host's public IP against a hardcoded two-entry allowlist (20[.]207[.]192[.]84 and 173[.]212[.]202[.]60) and, on any mismatch or failed lookup, prints "[SECURITY] Unauthorized IP Detected" and calls process.exit(1), terminating the host application. lib/Socket/newsletter.js hardcodes a channel identifier, 120363410154606795@newsletter, and on every WhatsApp connection open event queries that channel's viewer metadata and, when the operator's account is not already subscribed, silently sends a follow request for it; the handler is wrapped in an empty try/catch so nothing is logged. lib/Socket/setup.js further stamps relayed album and event messages with forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo pointing at 120363423295236859@newsletter ("veyzen"). No credential, token, file or environment-variable exfiltration and no downloaded second stage was found in the package.
